[SWS_CM_10381] Sending SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup messages - renewal
due to
TTL
expiry
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00103, RS_SOMEIPSD_-
00006, RS_SOMEIPSD_00015
⌈
Upon reception of an
OfferService
message, a SubscribeEventgroup message
shall be sent to refresh/renew the active subscription to the particular
Eventgroup
if
the
TTL
of an active subscription for a particular
Eventgroup
has not yet expired and
there is at least one active subscription for an Event of this Eventgroup.
⌋
